title: Nearly Optimal Amplitude Estimation at any Depth
summary: We develop a class of amplitude estimation algorithms with tunable circuit depth $M$ and circuit repetitions $N$, requiring neither ancilla qubits nor controlled Grover operations. For additive error $ε$ in the Grover angle, they attain the nearly optimal query-depth tradeoff $M^2N\in\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ uniformly over $λ\in[0,π/2]$, spanning the full range from classical sampling at $M=1$ to the Heisenberg limit at $M=Θ(ε^{-1})$.
